idea-plugin.name: Vibe Action
idea-plugin.description:
Native IDE panel for Vibe Action — a command router that executes shell commands and LLM prompts via simple YAML flows.

Vibe Action already works standalone through clipboard + External Tools — this plugin removes that friction. Instead of hand-configuring External Tools.xml and memorizing keybindings, get a panel that discovers available flows (built-in and custom YAML) and runs them with visible feedback, right inside the IDE.

  • Discovery — see every available action, including your own custom YAML flows, without per-project setup
  • Feedback — see what's happening while a flow runs, instead of waiting on a system notification

Requires the vibe-action CLI installed and available on PATH.
